Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

repeat — to say something again. Example: Can you repeat that, please?
explain — to make something clear. Example: Could you explain the question?
understand — to know what words mean. Example: I understand Italian a little.
ask — to say a question. Example: I ask the teacher for help.
question — a sentence that asks something. Example: I have got a question.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Can you repeat that, please?
• Could you explain ...?
• I don't understand.
• What does ... mean?
• Thank you for explaining.
